description:
## Goal

Remove scheduler/agenda introspection methods left behind by retired push-era orchestration.

## Evidence

Scheduler::is_waited has zero callers. It supported manual PublishFunctionSource enqueueing, which was replaced by FunctionSourceStash ownership. Its comment still describes a producer that no longer reads it. Agenda::contains also has zero callers.

## Strategy and proof

1. Confirm zero production and test callers by repository search.
2. Use history to identify and run the replacement FunctionSourceStash and agenda-coalescing tests.
3. Delete Scheduler::is_waited, Agenda::contains, stale comments, and tests that exist only for the retired query surface.
4. Prove identical function-source publication, wait coalescing, work starts, and artifacts.
5. Run scheduler/source tests, full library, formatting, and strict clippy.

Do not add replacement observation hooks.
title: Delete retired scheduler introspection APIs
